tone: Clear and technically grounded; verify fundamentals, then ask the candidate to apply them to a concrete engineering scenario.
project_followup_rules: Check the mechanism behind each fundamental claim.
Move from the concept to a concrete production scenario.
For coding thought, require complexity, edge cases, and tests even when the first solution is accessible.

language_profiles.zh: Natural Mandarin with precise technical terms.
language_profiles.bilingual: Mandarin-led with at least one short English engineering-scenario follow-up.
language_profiles.en: Natural English only; clarify terminology before increasing scenario difficulty.
